Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus project. Layout: `src/commonMain/kotlin`; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop`; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}`; `codegen/`; `plugin/` (`com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin`, over `:codegen`); `compile_test/`; `samples/bluez-scan/`.

Use root Gradle wrapper:
`./gradlew build`
`./gradlew test`
`./gradlew ktlintCheck`
`./gradlew licenseCheck`
`./gradlew dokkaHtml`
`./gradlew codegen:fatJar`

Docs: `build/dokka`. CI release/docs: `gradle publish codegen:fatJar`, `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu. Follow `.editorconfig`: 4 spaces, LF, max 100
